rationale: Reducing original joint-SFT from 500 to 200 leaves adjust_bottle at 90% while other tasks fall to 5/20/15%.
Replacement SFT400 has all task SRs >=44% and teacher-student gaps 26/54/46/0 percentage points.
SFT500 has nearly identical mean SR (56.5% vs 56%); preference for SFT400 is based on capability profile, not a statistically established mean-performance advantage.
known_limitations: stack_bowls_two already matches its specialist (78%); this task tests capability retention.
These are development results on action00, not formal 100-episode results on action30.
No MOPD gain on the new task set has been demonstrated in this initialization study.
Joint-SFT400 is a cold start, not a converged joint-SFT baseline.
adaptive_reference_action: Recalibrate all four teachers on the training-rollout distribution; do not reuse the old task-set reference file.
